title: Hire abroad via an EOR
summary: Employ someone in a country where you have no entity: an employer-of-record hires them locally on your behalf — quote the country cost, generate the compliant contract, run the checks, and stand up local payroll and benefits. Contractors abroad live in Hire intl contractor; full foreign subsidiaries are a post-Series-B problem.

parts.title: Choose the EOR and check country employment costs
parts.guidance: Compare employment routes using the worker’s country, role, compensation and the company’s local presence. Get country-specific proposals showing the legal employer, employment costs, deposits, benefits, termination support and remaining company duties. Review suitability with the people and finance leads and local adviser before choosing EOR or direct employment. Settle who owns contracts, payroll inputs and employee questions under the chosen arrangement.

options.title: Default — Choose the EOR and check country employment costs
options.summary: Compare the EOR’s proposal for the specific worker and country: legal employer, employment obligations, full cost, company duties and support contacts. Resolve suitability with local advice before engaging the provider or issuing terms. Agree who supplies payroll inputs, answers employee questions and handles changes or termination. Check outstanding conditions before sharing candidate information through the onboarding process.

options.title: Own entity - direct local payroll
options.summary: Assess whether the local entity is ready to employ this person directly. Identify registrations, employment documents, benefits, reporting and ongoing administration with local advisers and payroll. Compare the complete workload and cost with the EOR proposal before choosing the route. An existing entity does not by itself establish employer readiness or make direct employment the cheaper arrangement.
options.when: You already have a local entity in the hiring country - skip the EOR margin

parts.title: Generate the quote and locally compliant contract
parts.guidance: Request the country-specific quote and draft using the agreed role and compensation details. Reconcile salary, statutory costs, benefits, fees, deposits and currency assumptions, then review the proposed employment terms with the people lead and local adviser. Resolve discrepancies between the commercial quote and candidate-facing agreement before committing to either. Share candidate information only through the authorized onboarding channel.

parts.title: Candidate signs the employment agreement with the EOR
parts.guidance: Make sure the candidate knows which entity will employ them and has the reviewed terms and a contact for questions. Release the approved version through the EOR’s signing process, then check execution by the candidate and employer, effective date and unfinished conditions. Give onboarding the settled start details; right-to-work clearance and payroll readiness remain separate checks.

parts.title: Right-to-work and background checks
parts.guidance: Ask the EOR specialist which right-to-work and screening checks are lawful and required for this country and role. Agree the consent, evidence-collection, review and dispute process before ordering checks, with the people lead authorizing their scope. Keep sensitive reports with the authorized reviewers and share only necessary status updates. Resolve any start-blocking condition before clearing the employee to begin.

parts.title: Set up country payroll, benefits, and equipment
parts.guidance: Compare the executed employment terms with the EOR’s payroll and benefits setup: pay currency, funding schedule, coverage dates and local support. Resolve incomplete employee onboarding that could delay pay. Coordinate equipment delivery, ownership and support, using the normal purchasing process. Give the employee and manager a start-readiness view showing what is ready and who is handling anything still missing.

parts.title: Provision workspace and system access
parts.guidance: Use the employee’s duties, manager and start clearance to identify required systems, groups and device controls. Obtain the relevant system-owner access decisions and provision the verified company identity. Have the employee complete authentication setup and check essential work resources. Assign company and EOR contacts for future access changes and offboarding.

metadata.supportReason: EOR platforms quote, contract, and run country payroll through APIs; the country/cost decision and the candidate’s employment signature stay human.
